question: How does the supreme Kaula power become the power of emission?
premises: That same supreme power, by the force of stirring, becomes emission.
This is stated in the Trishiras scripture.
It is stated in the discussion that culminates in the pervasion of the kalas.
inference: The stirring of the supreme Kaula power manifests as visarga, the act of emanative emission.
plain_english: That same power, stirred into motion, certainly becomes the power of emission. This is taught in the Trishiras scripture in the section dealing with the pervasion of the kalas.
